pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients and high contrast. Patch size is largest on the upper flank, showing a progressive reduction in area and increased fragmentation toward the lower ventral region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit trivalent and tetravalent connectivity. Pathway width is uniform across the mid-flank with slight broadening at nodal points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder transition. Silhouette edges are distinct against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, dark, textured lesion located on the central and lower flank. The area shows significant hyper-pigmentation and a nodular surface texture that disrupts the standard pelage pattern.
